name: FIF to MNE Raw
summary: Converts one or more MEG/EEG FIF files to MNE-Python Raw with mne.io.read_raw_fif, optionally reassigning channel types and renaming channels, and outputs the raw file(s) with a channel QC report.
description: Reads each FIF file with MNE-Python, applies optional channel-type reassignments (for example spare EEG channels used for EOG/ECG) and channel renames, and re-saves it as raw.fif (or raw_<n>.fif for several inputs) with an HTML report of the channel information. Use it to bring FIF recordings into the brainlife MNE pipeline in a consistent format. Supersedes the single-file bl.app.632 registration.

inputs.description: One or more MEG/EEG recordings in FIF format, with optional BIDS sidecars, calibration and cross-talk files.

outputs.description: MNE raw data: raw.fif for a single input, or raw_<n>.fif per input file.

parameters.description: Optional channel-type reassignments, comma-separated "chan_name-new_type" pairs (e.g. "EEG061-eog,EEG062-eog,EEG063-ecg,EEG064-misc" for a system that digitizes EOG/ECG through spare EEG channels). Applied via MNE's set_channel_types() before saving. Default: no reassignment.
Optional channel renames, comma-separated "old_name-new_name" pairs (e.g. "EEG061-EOG061,EEG062-EOG062,EEG063-ECG063"). Applied via MNE's rename_channels(), after channel_types. Default: no renaming.

citations.text: Hayashi S., Caron B. A., Heinsfeld A. S. et al. brainlife.io: a decentralized and open-source cloud platform to support neuroscience research. Nature Methods 21, 809-813 (2024).
Gramfort A. et al. MEG and EEG data analysis with MNE-Python. Frontiers in Neuroscience 7:267 (2013).
